reason: Backend conventions index for Training Module, routes, database and service boundaries.
P1 requires schema, migration, transaction, concurrency and outbox patterns.
New protocol and route failures must use project domain-error mapping.
Training answers and event payloads must not leak into logs or audit metadata.

Frontend conventions index for the P3 training and trend UI.
Training timing, visibility and imperative guards must follow existing hook patterns.
Trend and protocol DTOs must have shared typed boundaries without local casts.

M5 spans event payloads, services, projections, routes and UI consumers.
Protocol decoding and metric direction must remain single-source and reusable.
